steps.title: How this test works
steps.body: The TCF Canada speaking test has three tasks: a short talk about yourself, a role-play and an opinion. Here you practise useful sentences out loud and choosing the right reply. At A1 you say your name, where you live and what you do.

steps.tip: Say your own name. Speak slowly and clearly.

steps.fr: J'habite à Toronto et je travaille dans un magasin.
steps.en: I live in Toronto and I work in a shop.
steps.tip: Replace the city and the job with your own.

steps.fr: Je voudrais un café, s'il vous plaît.
steps.en: I would like a coffee, please.
steps.tip: Je voudrais is a polite way to ask for something.

steps.prompt: The examiner asks the question below. What do you answer?
The examiner asks the question below. Which answer fits?
steps.explain: Où habitez-vous asks where you live.
